name: What kind of preventative maintenance can I do for my laundry drain?

mainEntity.name: What kind of preventative maintenance can I do for my laundry drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent laundry drain clogs, regularly clean your washing machine's lint trap, avoid overloading the machine, and use high-efficiency detergents to reduce soap scum buildup. Occasionally running an empty hot water cycle with a cup of white vinegar can also help. For long-term prevention, consider scheduling periodic professional drain cleaning, especially if you have an older plumbing system.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent laundry clogs by cleaning the lint trap, using efficient detergents, and occasionally running a hot water cycle with vinegar.
